Cannon Spike.name: Cannon Spike
Cannon Spike.summary: Cannon Spike (released in Japan as Gunspike) is a top-down run-and-gun shooting game developed by Psikyo & published by Capcom in the year 2000. Players select from a roster of classic Capcom characters, then play through a series of short stages & boss battles in a randomly selected order.

Hello Kitty no Otonaru Mail.name: Hello Kitty no 'Otonaru' Mail
Hello Kitty no Otonaru Mail.summary: Hello Kitty no 'Otonaru' Mail is a Japan-only Hello Kitty Dreamcast game. It has online functions that allow users to communicate with friends by sending mail using Hello Kitty characters.

Stunt GP.name: Stunt GP
Stunt GP.summary: And RC car racing game where doing spins, flips and other stunts earns you points that can be exchanged for upgrades.
